input.quote: 30. FORCE MAJEURE. TrueLink will be excused from delays in performing or from failing to perform its obligations under this Agreement to the extent the delays or failures result from causes beyond the reasonable control or TrueLink.
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns no hits, and a read of the general/miscellaneous provisions (Sections 13-30, p0078-p0097) confirms there is no insurance covenant anywhere in the Agreement. TrueLink is a hosting vendor that operates Client's web site and processes consumer mortgage and credit-repository data, so the absence of any coverage requirement is walk-away territory under the rule (no insurance for a vendor processing personal data). Inserted a new Section 31 immediately after the final miscellaneous provision (Force Majeure) at the preferred position: CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, and certificates on request; the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) is offered in the comment. Note that the survival clause at p0090 refers to "Sections 1 and 5 through 30" and would ideally be conformed to include the new section, but that is a minor drafting point rather than a separate deviation.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 31 requiring TrueLink to carry commercial general liability, professional liability (E&O) and cyber liability insurance, with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance provision, so we added standard coverages appropriate for a vendor that hosts our web site and processes consumer credit data, together with certificates on request. If USD 5,000,000 cyber cover is not currently in place, we can accept E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: 31. INSURANCE. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (a) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (b) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (c) cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering Client Content and any other data of Client or its customers processed, hosted or transmitted by TrueLink; and (d) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance evidencing such coverage upon request.
